environment.dbus: optional boolean, preserving unspecified versus false
environment.name: safe ASCII shell identifier, maximum 255 bytes

effects.environment: process/child environment and optional external activation-service propagation
effects.command: external effect, never executed by import/editor/ordinary preview
effects.permission: first-launch-only rule registration; enforcement is separate

limits_of_support: Static strings and single-command lifecycle callbacks. Optional command launch-rule tables, arbitrary callbacks, dynamic environment evaluation, complete workflow programming and live enforcement remain unresolved. This schema is not a native acceptance or runtime certificate.

legacy_command.lua_export: refused; no implicit conversion of launch-rule semantics
